fluff.overview: The Hellion is a 30-ton Clan OmniMech introduced in 3059 by Clan Ice Hellion, embodying that Clan's deep-seated philosophy of swift, decisive warfare. Designed by the Hector MechWorks Facility Alpha as a heavier evolution of the proven Mist Lynx chassis, the Hellion was intended to fill the role of a fast striker and headhunter capable of keeping pace with the Ice Hellions' aggressive doctrines. The design achieves a remarkable balance of speed, protection, and pod space for its weight class, incorporating endo steel construction and ferro-fibrous armor to maximize payload capacity. Following the destruction of Clan Ice Hellion during Operation ICE STORM, the Hellion has proliferated widely among the Successor Clans, with production lines established on Valencia by the Scorpion Empire and on Svarstaad by Clan Hell's Horses.
fluff.capabilities:
The Hellion is built around a 210-rated XL engine that propels the thirty-ton OmniMech to a cruising speed of 75 kph, with a maximum sprint of 118 kph. The integration of a myomer acceleration signal circuitry system allows the Hellion to achieve burst speeds of up to 151 kph, enabling it to outrun many designs in its weight class and even keep pace with lighter 'Mechs. Five and a half tons of Compound Gamma ferro-fibrous armor provide exceptional survivability for a light OmniMech, making the Hellion especially difficult to bring down compared to its peers.

With 11.5 tons of available pod space, the Hellion offers more flexibility than many competing designs of similar or even greater mass, including the Ice Ferret and Viper. The Prime configuration exemplifies the design's versatility, mounting four ER medium lasers and a trio of Streak SRM-2 launchers for devastating close-range headhunter engagements, while an LRM-10 provides the ability to harass targets at longer ranges. This combination of speed, durability, and reconfigurable firepower has made the Hellion a preferred command unit for light Stars, where its superior toughness relative to other light OmniMechs provides an important measure of survivability for Star Commanders leading from the front.
fluff.history:
The Hellion was born from Clan Ice Hellion's relentless pursuit of speed as a battlefield virtue. Produced at the Hector MechWorks Facility Alpha beginning in 3059, the design quickly became one of the most popular 'Mechs in the Ice Hellion touman, prized both for its performance and its symbolic connection to the Clan's namesake predator. The honor of piloting a Hellion was fiercely contested through Trials, and the design became synonymous with Ice Hellion combat doctrine.

The Hellion saw its most significant early combat during Operation ICE STORM in 3071, when Clan Ice Hellion launched its ill-fated invasion of the Inner Sphere. On Romulus, Hellions of the Seventh Attack Cluster employed their signature speed and aggression against the First Falcon Hussars, executing slashing hit-and-run attacks in and around Remus City. The light OmniMechs proved devastatingly effective in headhunter operations, eliminating key Jade Falcon officers and forcing the disorganized Hussars to retreat off-world. Despite these tactical successes, Operation ICE STORM ultimately led to the destruction of Clan Ice Hellion as a political entity.

The Hellion survived its parent Clan's demise, however. As the Ice Hellions were absorbed by Clan Goliath Scorpion (later the Escorpion Imperio and then the Scorpion Empire) the design remained deeply popular among former Hellion warriors, particularly within the Hellion Galaxy. Manufacturing was eventually established at the Prosoma War Works on Valencia, ensuring continued production for the Empire's military. Simultaneously, large numbers of Hellions were seized as isorla by Clan Jade Falcon and Clan Hell's Horses during the chaos of Operation ICE STORM. The Horses proved particularly fond of the design, finding its speed and agility perfectly suited to their combined-arms Mongol horde tactics.

Clan Hell's Horses eventually established their own Hellion production line at the Svarstaad Industriplex Alpha, developing new configurations optimized for their distinctive combat doctrine. By 3147, during Operation Noyan, packs of Horse Hellions were employed against Jade Falcon garrisons on Colmar, racing ahead of the main body to skirmish enemy outriders and disrupt communications with ECM while unleashing devastating close-range laser fusillades. When encountering entrenched defenses, the Hellions called in massed artillery strikes from supporting Stars, demonstrating the design's evolution from a pure headhunter into an integral element of combined-arms operations. A surprising number of Hellions have also surfaced in the Clan Occupation Zones through commercial channels, likely stemming from the loss of an entire shipment from Hector to the Diamond Sharks.
fluff.deployment: Alternate Configuration C is widely regarded as one of the Hellion's most effective headhunter loadouts. An ATM-6 launcher provides flexible ammunition options across all engagement ranges, while four ER medium lasers are linked to a targeting computer for significantly enhanced accuracy. This combination of precision laser fire and adaptable missile support, developed in cooperation with Clan Coyote, makes the configuration exceptionally lethal against enemy command elements. The targeting computer integration allows MechWarriors to place shots with surgical precision during high-speed passes, capitalizing on the Hellion's speed to create fleeting but decisive engagement windows against priority targets.
